run_extract_wav2vec_features: run wav2vec feature extraction from audio files listed in a TSV split using a checkpoint model
run_Wav2VecFeatureReader_get_feats: run the Wav2VecFeatureReader to extract features from a single audio file at a given path
run_Wav2VecFeatureReader_read_audio: run the Wav2VecFeatureReader to load an audio file and return PCM data with sample rate
run_get_iterator: run get_iterator to create a generator that yields wav2vec features for each audio file in a TSV split
run_get_parser: run get_parser to build an argparse parser for wav2vec feature extraction with data, split, checkpoint, and layer args
